title: Operations Manager (Product)
description:

About Revolut  People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role  At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth. We’re looking for a Product Operations Manager to help shape how we continue to expand and operate across the globe. You’ll work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers. Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch. What you’ll be doing  Developing a point of view on specific fintech verticals and defining a cohesive long-term strategy for the company and product departments Acting as the eyes and ears of the company, feeding information from the market back into company strategy and department roadmaps Tracking and analysing competitive position and product performance globally Helping scope and launch new verticals for the company Defining initial product proposition and go-to-market strategies for new expansion markets  What you'll need  At least a 2:1 degree from a top university A STEM or other highly quantitative degree from a top-tier university A track record of outstanding achievement in different areas 3+ years of experience in a strategy consulting, investment banking/PE/VC, or fast-growing technology company in a product or strategy role Great problem-solving skills A focus on customer-centric designs and solutions  Nice to have  A track record of building successful products (ideally financial) using data, customer feedback, common sense, and/or machine learning  Compensation range  Krakow: PLN19,500 - PLN21,600 gross monthly* Poland: PLN19,500 - PLN21,600 gross monthly* Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process  *Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates:  Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles. • Only apply through official Revolut channels.  We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. • Always double-check the emails you receive.  Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain. We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.  If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately. By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Customer Success Manager em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

WHO ARE WE?  We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy! CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention. Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including: CloudSEK’s Product Suite:  CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support. A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets. CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies. Key Milestones:  2016: Launched our first product. 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding. 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas. 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year. 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures. Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's \"Best Growth Strategy Award,\" CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award. 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.  Job Description:  As a Customer Success Manager at CloudSEK , you will be the primary point of contact for a few strategic accounts, ensuring they derive maximum value from our cybersecurity solutions . Your role will involve deep engagement with clients , providing expert guidance on threat management, and ensuring seamless integration and utilization of CloudSEK’s products . Your background in cybersecurity will be crucial in understanding and addressing the specific needs and challenges faced by our clients. Key Responsibilities:  Account Management:  Manage and nurture relationships for a client accounts, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and retention. Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and Annual Business Reviews (ABRs) to assess and enhance customer engagement. Visit customers twice a year to strengthen relationships and understand their evolving needs.  Cybersecurity Expertise:  Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and other cybersecurity issues. Act as a security analyst, offering insights and recommendations based on threats generated by CloudSEK’s platform. Collaborate with customer security teams to ensure optimal usage of CloudSEK’s solutions.  Customer Engagement:  Develop and execute customer engagement strategies to build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including CXOs and CISOs. Foster customer champions within client organizations to drive advocacy and referrals. Generate and share client-specific quality reports, gathering feedback to continuously improve service delivery.  Revenue Generation and Retention:  Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling CloudSEK’s products and services. Ensure on-time renewals and maintain a high customer retention rate. Source referrals and participate in revenue generation activities.  Product Usage and Feedback:  Ensure 100% product usage for features subscribed by the customers. Conduct configuration reviews and provide recommendations for product enhancements. Gather and analyze customer feedback to contribute to product development and improvement.  Operational Excellence:  Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and activities in CRM systems. Contribute to the team by sharing knowledge, conducting training sessions, and writing internal articles.  Ideal candidate:   4-5 years of experience in Cybersecurity & Client-facing experience, or a related role in the cybersecurity industry.  Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, threat intelligence, and digital risk management.  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with clients. Strong language proficiency over English and Portuguese is required.  Proven track record of achieving customer success goals and driving revenue growth.  Ability to work independently and manage multiple accounts  simultaneously.  Cookie points if you have experience in the below skills:  Business reviews: Onsite meetings Maintaining NRR and GRR Threat analysis and Value delivery  Benefits of Joining CloudSEK:   We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include: Flexible working hours. Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office. And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here! CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

title: Head of Liquidity LATAM
description:
Empresa está contratando Head of Liquidity LATAM em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

About the Company  We are a leading digital asset platform that provides trading, brokerage, custody, and infrastructure solutions for institutional and professional investors. As the business continues to grow, they are seeking an experienced liquidity professional to lead and enhance their global liquidity capabilities. Role Overview  This leadership role is responsible for overseeing liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX markets in LATAM, ensuring efficient market access, strong execution quality, and robust liquidity coverage across trading products. The successful candidate will work closely with Trading, Sales, Product, Risk, Compliance, Treasury, and Technology teams to support the firm's institutional trading business. We cover stablecoins, on/off ramp and cross-border payments as well. Candidates with relevant experiences will be prioritized. Key Responsibilities  Liquidity Management  Develop and execute the firm's liquidity strategy across digital asset and FX-related markets. Source, onboard, and manage relationships with liquidity providers, market makers, brokers, exchanges, and banking partners. Monitor liquidity quality, market depth, pricing competitiveness, and venue performance. Ensure sufficient liquidity coverage across supported products and trading activities.  FX & Trading Operations  Oversee liquidity and execution across FX and digital asset trading flows. Monitor market developments and identify opportunities to improve execution performance and pricing. Analyze trading activity, transaction costs, spreads, and execution metrics. Partner with trading and treasury teams to optimize execution workflows and market access.  Counterparty & Vendor Management  Build and maintain relationships with key liquidity providers and institutional counterparties. Support commercial negotiations, fee discussions, and service-level reviews. Conduct ongoing assessments and due diligence of trading venues and liquidity partners.  Risk & Governance  Work closely with Risk and Compliance teams to ensure appropriate controls and oversight. Monitor counterparty, settlement, and liquidity-related risks. Support contingency planning and business continuity measures during periods of market stress.  Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement  Lead and develop the liquidity function. Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Trading, Treasury, Product, Technology, Risk, and Compliance teams. Provide management reporting on liquidity performance, market developments, and strategic initiatives.  Requirements  Significant experience in liquidity management, electronic trading, FX trading, market structure, market making, brokerage, or institutional trading environments. Experience sourcing, evaluating, and managing relationships with liquidity providers, brokers, market makers, exchanges, and banking partners. Strong understanding of FX and/or digital asset liquidity ecosystems and execution practices. Ability to analyze execution quality, transaction costs, and liquidity performance metrics. Commercially minded with strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills. Experience working within regulated financial services environments. Excellent communication, leadership, and relationship management capabilities.

We are looking for a remote, full-time Product Owner  with 3-5 years of product owner or technical product manager experience. In this role, you will bridge the client needs and technical execution, managing both high-touch, custom audience requests and the development of the client's syndicated audience products. As the Product Owner, you must be strategic and detail-oriented as you lead the end-to-end product lifecycle. You will own the \"how\" and \"when\" of our audience delivery, collaborating closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Client Success teams to ensure every segment release is built to specification, rigorously QA'd, and delivered on schedule. If you are a self-starter who enjoys a fast-paced, dynamic, and autonomous environment and thrives in challenging situations, Collage is the place for you. You will be at the heart of our data engine, directly impacting how our clients understand and reach their customers. This is a high-visibility role where your ability to streamline processes and ensure data integrity will be a key driver of the company's growth. Our client unleashes the power of culture, driving brand growth with consumer insights, analytics, tools, and best practices for over 250 iconic U.S. brands. Its solutions are fueled by its cultural intelligence platform, which allows its customers to more effectively and efficiently understand, reach, and engage consumers while the U.S. undergoes significant demographic shifts. Brands build cultural fluency to activate consumers across race, ethnicity, generations, gender, and sexual identity. Our client comprises creative, analytical, diverse, hardworking, and fun individuals with an insatiable curiosity for the new collage of behaviors and patterns driving consumers today. The possibilities of the moment and opportunity to help organizations unlock their cultural capacity inspire them to seek out predictive insights and brand impacts that are unique to their model. Responsibilities  End-to-End Delivery:  Own the scoping, building, QA, and release phases for all custom and syndicated audience segments Cross-Functional Leadership:  Act as the primary point of contact between stakeholders and the Data Science team responsible for building audiences to translate complex marketing requirements into technical roadmaps Backlog Management:  Prioritize the audience creation queue, balancing urgent custom requests from enterprise clients with long-term product goals, including audience pipeline improvements Quality Assurance:  Develop and oversee rigorous QA protocols to ensure audience accuracy before release Process Optimization:  Continuously refine the audience build workflow to reduce \"time-to-market\" for new segments Market Insight:  Stay ahead of trends in MarTech and identity resolution to ensure Collage's segmentation capabilities remain best-in-class  Required Experience  Communication Skills : Excellent English communication skills Proven PO Experience :3–5 years of professional experience in a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager role, specifically within an Agile environment MarTech Experience : A deep understanding of the marketing technology ecosystem , specifically regarding audience segmentation, DMPs, CDPs, or programmatic advertising Agile Software:  Proficiency in Jira, Monday.com, or Azure DevOps for backlog grooming and sprint planning Data Literacy:  Ability to speak \"data\"—comfortable discussing SQL, data schemas, or statistical confidence with technical peers Data Science Collaboration : A track record of successfully managing projects that involve complex data modeling, large datasets, and collaboration with data scientists Project Precision : Demonstrated ability to manage multiple high-stakes projects simultaneously without losing sight of the \"fine print\" during the QA process Stakeholder Influence : Experience navigating the needs of both commercial/sales teams and technical engineering teams to find the optimal path forward High Impact Delivery : Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment Soft Skills : Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent  Desired Experience  Marketing Platforms:  Familiarity with how audiences are activated in platforms like LiveRamp, Trade Desk, or Facebook Manager  Additional Information  Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big! You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions Work with smart and creative people Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent! We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you! 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays Start: ASAP  About Velozient  We are a rapidly growing, nearshore company providing expert Latin American resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer expert talent that enjoys taking on challenging work, wants to grow their skills and experiences, and excels in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class, remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Atuar com visão ponta a ponta do ecossistema de dados, compreendendo: Fluxos de dados em arquiteturas modernas (Bronze → Silver → Gold); Linhagem e gestão ativa de metadados; Controles de acesso e segregação de dados; Técnicas de mascaramento, anonimização e proteção de dados. Definir e operacionalizar papéis e responsabilidades de governança: Data Owners; Data Stewards e Custodiantes. Integrar práticas de governança à esteira de desenvolvimento de dados, automatizando controles e reduzindo fricção para os times de engenharia. Atuar em parceria com Segurança da Informação, Privacidade, Jurídico e Compliance em temas relacionados a auditoria, conformidade e resposta a incidentes. Apoiar demandas regulatórias, auditorias e requisições relacionadas a titulares de dados. Definir, acompanhar e comunicar métricas e indicadores de: Maturidade de governança; Qualidade de dados. Promover cultura orientada a dados e disseminar boas práticas de governança na organização, atuando como referência técnica no tema. Conhecimento sólido e aplicado em: Catalogação, classificação e gestão de metadados; Qualidade, linhagem e ciclo de vida de dados; Gestão de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis; LGPD e frameworks de governança e privacidade, como DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 27001 e SOC 2. Experiência atuando em conjunto com: Engenharia de Dados; Analytics; Segurança da Informação; Privacidade. Capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática; automatizada; integrada aos processos. Forte habilidade para: traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos aplicáveis; definir métricas e acompanhar evolução de maturidade; navegar com fluidez entre contextos técnicos, jurídicos e de negócio. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de simplificar temas complexos para diferentes públicos (Técnicos; Executivos; Áreas de negócio). Perfil com: Alta autonomia; Visão sistêmica; Capacidade de influência; Forte orientação a impacto e resultados. Capacidade de engajar áreas multifuncionais sem relação hierárquica direta. Perfil colaborativo, pragmático e orientado à construção de soluções escaláveis.  Seria muito legal se você tivesse (diferencial):  Experiência com: Databricks Unity Catalog, Arquiteturas Lakehouse; Ferramentas de catalogação, qualidade, observabilidade e linhagem de dados. Conhecimento prático em: SQL; Automação de controles; Políticas como código; Data contracts. Experiência com: Integração de logs de auditoria; Soluções de SIEM; Monitoramento de segurança. Certificações em: Governança de Dados; Privacidade; Segurança da Informação. Experiência em: Varejo; E-commerce; Ambientes de alta escala e volumetria de dados. title: Salesperson
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Salesperson em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview  Full Spectrum Search Group is a national healthcare recruiting firm focused on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice. We are hiring a Recruiter to execute on active searches and drive candidate engagement across our client portfolio. This role is responsible for identifying, engaging, and advancing top talent through the interview process. This is a phone-first, outbound recruiting role. Success in this position is driven by the ability to engage passive candidates  and turn initial outreach into meaningful conversations. If you are competitive, relationship-driven, and motivated by results, this role is for you. About the Role  This role sits at the core of our recruiting execution. You will partner with leadership and work closely with the operations and research team to identify and engage candidates for active searches. This is a production-driven role. Your success is measured by activity, candidate quality, and your ability to move candidates through the hiring process. There is a steep but rewarding learning curve. You will be expected to quickly learn both our recruiting process and the nuances of the post-acute healthcare industry, including terminology, roles, and market dynamics. Professional development is a core part of this role. The individuals who succeed here are those who actively invest in learning, improving, and refining their craft. Candidate Sourcing and Outreach  Proactively identify and engage passive candidates  through outbound calling, LinkedIn, CRM databases, referrals, and targeted call sheets Prioritize phone-based outreach  as the primary method of engagement, including calling candidates at their place of work when appropriate Utilize call lists and target data provided by the research team to execute structured outreach campaigns Supplement outreach with LinkedIn messaging, email, and text to increase response rates Manage and respond to inbound candidates (Indeed, LinkedIn, referrals), while maintaining a primary focus on outbound recruiting  Candidate Qualification and Assessment  Conduct high-quality screening calls with both outbound (passive) and inbound candidates Ask targeted, thoughtful questions to uncover experience, motivations, and openness to new opportunities Present opportunities in a clear, compelling way that resonates with passive candidates Accurately document candidate details including compensation expectations, timing, and potential barriers  Pipeline Management and Execution  Build and maintain a pipeline primarily driven by passive candidate outreach , not just inbound applicants Manage multiple active searches simultaneously while maintaining organization and momentum Ensure candidates are consistently moving through the process without delays Prepare candidates for client interviews, including expectations, positioning, and feedback Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Crelate and related systems  Client and Team Collaboration  Partner with leadership to align on candidate profiles and search priorities Communicate candidate updates, challenges, and market feedback in a timely manner Work closely with the operations and research team to ensure strong execution across all searches Contribute to team discussions around search strategy, candidate quality, and market trends  Performance Expectations  Maintain consistent daily call volume  with a strong emphasis on outbound phone activity Demonstrate the ability to engage and convert passive candidates into active conversations  Build a steady pipeline of qualified candidates sourced through outbound efforts Deliver a consistent number of qualified candidate presentations per week Maintain strong follow-up and response times with candidates and internal team members  What You’ll Bring  Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for professional U.S. business communication Understanding of American business culture, communication style, and professional expectations Comfort with high-volume outreach and phone-based recruiting Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain relationships with candidates Strong organization and time management skills Competitive, driven mindset with a desire to be successful Positive attitude and ability to keep pace with a fast-moving, high-performing team Strong technical proficiency and comfort learning new tools and systems Professional home office setup suitable for business calls Reliable high-speed internet and availability during U.S. business hours (Central Time)  What Separates Top Recruiters  You are comfortable calling candidates who are not actively looking and earning their interest You default to picking up the phone instead of relying solely on messages or applications You know how to turn a cold call into a meaningful career conversation You actively invest time in learning the industry, terminology, and roles you recruit for You generate your own pipeline rather than relying on inbound flow You maintain persistence and follow-through without being transactional  Ideal Background  Experience in recruiting, sales, or other high-activity, performance-driven roles Experience with outbound calling, business development, or candidate sourcing Familiarity with healthcare or executive recruiting is a plus, but not required Track record of meeting or exceeding performance expectations  Compensation and Logistics  Competitive monthly salary plus performance-based commission Full-time remote position Central Time schedule Performance-based growth opportunities

Somos a Vortigo  - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital. Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global. Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais. Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso? Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando: Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer)  para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh , com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos . Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia. Responsabilidades:  Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos. Automatizar processos  de provisionamento, backup, monitoramento e recuperação de bancos de dados. Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance. Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade  dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL. Participar da definição de padrões e políticas de governança de dados dentro da arquitetura Data Mesh. Realizar troubleshooting e tuning de queries e estruturas de dados. Gerenciar e otimizar recursos de banco de dados em AWS , utilizando serviços como RDS, Aurora, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM e Secrets Manager .  Requisitos Técnicos:  Experiência avançada com SQL Server , PostgreSQL  e MongoDB . Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura. Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC)  com Terraform ou CloudFormation . Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python . Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade  (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK). Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD)  e Data Mesh . Conhecimento em CI/CD  e integração com pipelines de dados. Experiência com ambientes cloud-native  e containers (Docker, Kubernetes) .  O que você encontra aqui:  Remote First  – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar. Comunidades Técnicas  – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos. Cultura de Feedback  – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI). Horário Flexível  - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho. Incentivo ao Idioma  - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso! Wellhub  - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo. Reembolso de Equipamentos  – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Nós, da Knewin , somos líderes na América Latina quando se trata de ajudar empresas e marcas a gerenciar sua reputação e presença online através de análises de dados. Com mais de 2.000  clientes, nosso objetivo é conectar nossos parceiros com seu público-alvo, visando conquistar sua preferência e alcançar resultados excepcionais para seus negócios. Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas. Estamos buscando uma Pessoa Analista de Remuneração e Dados SR  para compor o time de Pessoas da Knewin. Nessa posição, você será responsável por garantir que nossa estrutura de remuneração seja competitiva, justa e sustentável — ao mesmo tempo em que transforma dados de RH em inteligência estratégica para o negócio. É uma vaga para quem une rigor analítico com visão de processos, e que se interessa genuinamente por automação e pelo uso prático de IA no dia a dia de RH. Se você gosta de trabalhar com dados, entende de remuneração e quer atuar em um ambiente onde tecnologia e pessoas caminham juntas, essa posição é para você! title: QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
Confira a oportunidade para QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Us  Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview  As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities  1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)  Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.  2. Script-to-Audio Alignment  Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.  3. Technical & Creative Accuracy  Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble  4. Vendor & Artist Coordination  Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.  Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.  5. QC Documentation & Tracking  Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.  6. Pre-Release Quality Checks  Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.  7. Cross-Team Collaboration  Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.  8. Process Improvement  Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows. Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology  9. Volume & Deadline Management  Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content  within defined timelines. Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.  10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement  Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to: Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery  Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible. Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements. Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement. Qualifications  Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field. Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics. Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred. Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus. Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content. Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment. Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.  Language requirements  Fluent Portugese Professional working proficiency in English  This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis. Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Solutions Architect em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

At Sisense, we help organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization. Employment Type : Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)  WHY JOIN OUR SOLUTION ARCHITECT TEAM?  You will work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms. You will help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across Sisense environments. You will collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success to shape best practices and improve the platform. You will influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.  IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:  Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues. Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations. Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization. Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments. Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes. Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities. Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.  WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED… SO FAR:  5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect. Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE. Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix. Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB (or another NoSQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting. Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries. Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS. Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus. Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders.  HOW YOU’LL RAMP:  By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes. By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews. By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Empresa está contratando Lead Product Designer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Who are we?  Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role  This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities  Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.  Must haves  6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.  Nice to have  Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.  Please submit your application with an English-language CV/resume and a portfolio showcasing relevant work samples.

title: Controller Jurídico Sênior | Estruturação De Controladoria
description:

* Mapear e documentar fluxos operacionais internos; * Desenvolver indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e relatórios gerenciais; * Monitorar e controlar prazos processuais e administrativos; * Acompanhar produtividade e distribuição de demandas; * Identificar gargalos, riscos operacionais e oportunidades de melhoria; * Realizar auditorias internas de processos; * Apoiar a gestão na tomada de decisões estratégicas; * Garantir o cumprimento dos procedimentos internos e padrões de qualidade; * Atuar como elo entre as áreas operacional, jurídica e administrativa, comercial, financeiro.Requisitos* Experiência comprovada em Controladoria Jurídica; * Vivência com gestão de processos e indicadores; * Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados; * Facilidade para desenvolver procedimentos e acompanhar equipes; * Conhecimento de ferramentas de gestão e acompanhamento processual; * Domínio de Excel e indicadores gerenciais.Será um diferencial* Experiência em escritórios previdenciários; * Experiência em implantação de Controladoria Jurídica; * Conhecimento em Legal Operations (Legal Ops); * Vivência com projetos de melhoria contínua e gestão por processos.O que oferecemos✔️ Contratação CLT; ✔️ Vale-refeição; ✔️ Vale-transporte; ✔️ GymPass; ✔️ Ambiente colaborativo e estruturado; ✔️ Participação ativa em projetos estratégicos; ✔️ Oportunidade real de construir e desenvolver uma área essencial para o crescimento do escritório;
